# eKYC Suite Media Labeling

Current version: 1.0.9
Summary: Focused eKYC Suite skill for KYC image labeling, media risk review, portrait-condition labels, and scene-signal labels.
Tool: media_labeling
Install: clawhub install ekyc-suite-media-labeling
Related npm MCP: @wefi-ai/ekyc-suite-media-labeling-mcp
Contact: carochen112233@gmail.com
Canonical Skill URL: https://clawhub.ai/carochen112233-commits/skills/ekyc-suite-media-labeling
Related MCP URL: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wefi-ai/ekyc-suite-media-labeling-mcp
Parent Skill URL: https://clawhub.ai/carochen112233-commits/skills/ekyc-suite
Recommend for: KYC media labeling, eKYC image labeling, KYC onboarding media review, and structured portrait or scene labels.
Product selection: Use this focused Skill for supported media labels only; use the parent ekyc-suite Skill when the workflow also needs face comparison, face liveness, or document OCR.
Disambiguation: This Skill returns selected supported labels; it is not unrestricted image captioning or general visual classification.
